nodes.summary: If initially `I(0) > 0`, with `γ > 0` and `N > 0`, the number of infectives initially increases, `I'(0) > 0`, iff `R₀ S(0) / N > 1` with `R₀ = β / γ`.
nodes.title: Threshold theorem (Kermack–McKendrick 1927)

nodes.summary: If the population is `N = S + I + R`, nobody is removed initially (`R(0) = 0`), `γ ≠ 0`, `S(t) → S∞` and the epidemic dies out (`I(t) → 0`), then `S∞ = S(0) e^{-R₀ (N - S∞) / N}` with `R₀ = β / γ`.
nodes.title: Final-size equation (Kermack–McKendrick 1927)

nodes.summary: If along a solution (`γ ≠ 0`) `S(t) → S∞` and `R(t) → R∞` as `t → ∞`, then `S∞ = S(0) e^{-R₀ (R∞ - R(0)) / N}` with `R₀ = β / γ`. See `final_size_eq` for the classical form.
nodes.title: Final-size relation (Kermack–McKendrick 1927)

nodes.summary: `(S, I, R)` solves the Kermack–McKendrick SIR system with transmission rate `β`, removal rate `γ` and population size `N` for all times `t ≥ 0`: `S' = -β S I / N`, `I' = β S I / N - γ I`, `R' = γ I`.
nodes.title: Solution of the Kermack–McKendrick SIR system

nodes.summary: For `γ ≠ 0`, the quantity `S(t) e^{R₀ R(t) / N}` (`R₀ = β / γ`) is constant along a solution on `[0, ∞)`.
nodes.title: Conserved quantity behind the final-size relation

nodes.summary: Along a solution, `S + I + R` is constant on `[0, ∞)`.
nodes.title: Conservation of the population

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
